# coolify_notification_telegram (Data Source)

Reads the current team's Telegram notification settings. This is a team-scoped singleton (selected by the API token). Requires Coolify >= v4.3.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_notification_telegram" "current" {}

output "notifications" {
  value = data.coolify_notification_telegram.current.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `backup_failure` (Boolean) Whether Telegram notifications are sent for backup failure events.
- `backup_success` (Boolean) Whether Telegram notifications are sent for backup success events.
- `chat_id` (String, Sensitive) Telegram chat ID. Coolify may omit this unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root).
- `deployment_failure` (Boolean) Whether Telegram notifications are sent for deployment failure events.
- `deployment_success` (Boolean) Whether Telegram notifications are sent for deployment success events.
- `docker_cleanup_failure` (Boolean) Whether Telegram notifications are sent for Docker cleanup failure events.
- `docker_cleanup_success` (Boolean) Whether Telegram notifications are sent for Docker cleanup success events.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Telegram notifications are enabled for the team.
- `id` (String) Identifier. Always `current` (team is implied by the API token).
- `scheduled_task_failure` (Boolean) Whether Telegram notifications are sent for scheduled task failure events.
- `scheduled_task_success` (Boolean) Whether Telegram notifications are sent for scheduled task success events.
- `server_disk_usage` (Boolean) Whether Telegram notifications are sent for server disk usage events.
- `server_patch` (Boolean) Whether Telegram notifications are sent for server patch events.
- `server_reachable` (Boolean) Whether Telegram notifications are sent for server reachable events.
- `server_unreachable` (Boolean) Whether Telegram notifications are sent for server unreachable events.
- `status_change` (Boolean) Whether Telegram notifications are sent for status change events.
